description: Address code review issues: fix schema mismatch in front controllers, complete uninstall.sql, fix CSRF bypass, add path traversal protection, encrypt PESEL, add double-booking prevention, gate PS_SHOP_NAME overwrite, fix consent export response handling.
steps: Fix schema mismatch in bookingflow.php, dashboard.php, doctorprofile.php, doctorsearch.php to use actual tables (medbook_resource, medbook_resource_lang, medbook_doctor_profile, medbook_specialization, medbook_clinic, medbook_doctor_clinic)
Complete uninstall.sql to DROP all tables created by install.sql
Fix CSRF bypass in cartbooking.php - always require token validation
Add path traversal protection in DocumentService::download()
Add PESEL encryption in PrescriptionService using openssl
Add UNIQUE index on (id_resource, booking_date, time_start, time_end) in install.sql
Gate PS_SHOP_NAME overwrite to only run on fresh install
Fix consent controller export to use ob_end_clean + die() pattern
acceptance_criteria: All front controllers query existing tables with correct column names
uninstall.sql drops all 24+ tables from install.sql
CSRF token is always required in cartbooking.php
DocumentService validates resolved path stays within upload directory
PESEL is encrypted before storage and decrypted on retrieval
install.sql has unique constraint preventing double-bookings
PS_SHOP_NAME is only set if current value is default or empty
Consent export uses ob_end_clean + die() pattern
All PHP files pass syntax check
verification: Run: find /projects/sandbox/PrestaShop/modules/medbook_booking/ -name '*.php' -exec php -l {} \; | grep -v 'No syntax errors'
findings: All 8 review issues addressed. Front controllers rewritten to use medbook_resource + medbook_resource_lang + medbook_doctor_profile + medbook_specialization + medbook_clinic + medbook_doctor_clinic with correct column names. uninstall.sql now drops all 25 tables. CSRF always required (no bypass for empty tokens). Path traversal blocked via realpath + str_starts_with boundary check. PESEL encrypted at rest with AES-256-CBC, decrypted on read, pesel column widened to VARCHAR(255). Double-booking prevented by UNIQUE KEY on (id_resource, booking_date, time_start, time_end). PS_SHOP_NAME only set when current value is default. Consent export uses ob_end_clean + die(). All PHP files pass syntax checks. Used git add -f for module files due to .gitignore pattern.
